name: Job Hunt Copilot
tagline: Paste your CV once, score any job in 30 seconds — tailored bullets, cover letter, interview pack.
description: Job Hunt Copilot turns 60 minutes of tailoring into 10. Save your CV (paste text or upload a PDF), paste any job description, and get a fit score with matched and missing keywords, paste-ready mirrored bullets, a forward-looking cover letter, and an interview prep pack mapped to your proof (Question / Your proof / Suggested answer, plus Situation-Task-Action-Result). Every application is tracked in a pipeline with 10-day follow-up nudges — drafts only, never auto-send. Honest by design: generated lines are checked against your CV word by word, and anything your CV doesn't say is offered only as an [ADD IF TRUE] suggestion, never as a claim. Profile URLs work for portfolio sites; LinkedIn blocks bots, so the app tells you to export your profile as a PDF instead of failing silently.
